headline: Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat to be Slowest
summary: The upcoming Bengaluru-Mangaluru-Goa Vande Bharat service is set to become the slowest chair car service in the country. Passengers can expect a journey duration of around 13 hours while enjoying views of the Western Ghats.

headline: First UK Charter Brings 300 Tourists
summary: Goa welcomed its first UK charter flight of the season, carrying 300 tourists from Manchester. Authorities expect around 20,000 visitors from the UK over the coming period.

headline: Goa College Launches Marriage Course
summary: A college in Goa has introduced a 15-day course aimed at preparing young adults for healthy and lasting marriages. The curriculum focuses on building relationship readiness among students.

headline: Ironman 70.3 Goa Conquered by Judge and Pilot
summary: A retired pilot and a Kerala High Court judge successfully completed the gruelling Ironman 70.3 race in Goa. Meanwhile, Indian Army's Biten Singh won the event and set a new course record.

headline: Goa Seeks Rs 1,000 Cr for Dam Upgrades
summary: The Goa government has sought Rs 1,000 crore for upgrading the Anjunem and Selaulim dams. The funds will be utilized to strengthen critical water infrastructure in the state.

headline: Mining Revival Faces Truck Demand Hurdles
summary: The revival of mining in South Goa is facing uncertainty due to local truck demand and transportation disputes. Chief Minister Pramod Sawant stepped in to help resolve the Sanvordem mining transport issues.

headline: Man Wins Refund Over Cancelled Flight
summary: A consumer won a Rs 18,000 settlement after being denied a full refund for a Goa-Delhi flight cancelled during Covid-19. The ruling penalised the airline for withholding the complete ticket amount.

headline: Bombay HC Orders ₹20 Lakh for Fire Victims
summary: The Bombay High Court has ordered the owners of a Goa nightclub to pay ₹20 lakh as compensation to the family of each victim following a fatal fire incident.

headline: Goa Supplies RDF to Cement Plants
summary: Goa has successfully supplied 7.6 lakh tonnes of Refuse-Derived Fuel (RDF) to cement plants to be used as an alternative energy source. This initiative supports the state's waste management and industrial fuel goals.

headline: Goa Adopts AI for Public Services
summary: The Goa government has signed an MoU with a US firm to adopt AI governance for disbursing welfare benefits and public schemes. Officials believe accurate data will improve evidence-based policymaking.

headline: Goa to Move SC Over ST Seat Order
summary: Goa is planning to approach the Supreme Court against a High Court order that stalled the ST seat reservation process. The state aims to clear legal hurdles surrounding the reservation framework.

headline: NHRACACB Invites CM to Awards
summary: A delegation from NHRACACB called on Chief Minister Pramod Sawant to invite him as a guest to their upcoming awards event.

headline: Human Rights Body Takes Cognizance of Water Crisis
summary: The Goa Human Rights Commission has taken suo motu cognisance of the severe drinking water crisis affecting residents in Barcem-Kaddem. Authorities have been pressed to address the civic grievance promptly.

headline: Ugandan National Granted Bail in Drug Case
summary: A local court has granted bail to a Ugandan national who was previously arrested for the alleged possession of heroin. Legal proceedings in the narcotics case will continue as per court directions.

headline: Churchill Brothers Face NorthEast
summary: Churchill Brothers are aiming to end their losing streak as they prepare to face an in-form NorthEast side. The team is looking to turn around their recent form on the football pitch.

headline: Exploring Architectural Heritage in Panaji
summary: A historic home in the heart of Goa’s capital showcases unique cultural aesthetics where traditional architecture meets local heritage.

headline: HC Scraps Bodgeshwar Temple Elections
summary: The High Court has scrapped the ongoing election process for the Bodgeshwar temple panel. The ruling sets aside the previous committee formation steps.

headline: Police Inspector Arrested for Minor's Assault
summary: A suspended crime branch police inspector and a co-accused have been arrested following allegations of sexually assaulting a 16-year-old minor. The case is being handled by the cyber crime division.

headline: Panchayats Told to Ban Plastic in Effigies
summary: Local panchayats have been directed to strictly enforce a ban on burning plastic materials inside Narkasur effigies during Diwali celebrations. The move aims to curb environmental pollution and hazards.

headline: Goa to Auction More Mining Blocks
summary: The Goa government announced plans to auction 8 to 9 additional mining blocks by December while issuing show-cause notices to non-operational leaseholders. The state aims to boost its mining potential and economic output.

headline: Low Rainfall Has Minor Impact on Crops
summary: Recent low rainfall levels have had a limited impact on the paddy crop across Goa, according to agricultural assessments. Farmers continue to manage irrigation alongside seasonal patterns.

headline: Rivar Group Signs Rs 3,000 Cr MoU
summary: The Rivar Group has signed a ₹3,000 crore MoU with the Goa government to establish an International Sports & Performance City. The project is expected to significantly boost sports infrastructure and tourism.

headline: Police Intercept Overcrowded Bus
summary: Goa police intercepted a bus that was dangerously crammed with 140 passengers despite having a permitted capacity of only 48. Action was taken against the vehicle for severe safety violations.

headline: Old Hurdles Cloud Sonsodo Kabrastan
summary: Fresh hopes for the Sonsodo kabrastan project continue to be clouded by long-standing bureaucratic and logistical hurdles. Local bodies are attempting to resolve land and clearance issues.
